title: The New Car
hook: 家里的红车送去修，一家人借了一辆蓝色新车，功能太多反而手忙脚乱。

cells.t: A Drive in the Red Car
cells.a: They were going for a drive in their red car.

cells.q: What did Daddy Pig say about the car?
cells.a: He said, “Our car loves us, too! Don't you?”
cells.cn: 他说：“我们的车也爱我们，对吧？”

cells.a: Granddad Dog runs the garage. He is good at mending cars.
cells.cn: 狗爷爷开修车厂，很会修车。

cells.q: What did the man ask them?
cells.a: He asked, “Would you like the roof down?”
cells.cn: 他问要不要把车顶打开。

cells.q: Did the family like the new car?
cells.a: Yes, they liked the new blue car very much.
cells.cn: 他们很喜欢这辆新蓝车。

cells.a: She said, “Daddy! Make the magic windows go down.”
cells.cn: 她说：“爸爸！让神奇的窗子降下来。”

cells.a: He wondered which button closes the roof.
cells.cn: 他在想哪个按钮才能关车顶。

cells.a: They asked, “Can we open the roof again?”
cells.cn: 他们问能不能再打开车顶。

cells.q: Which car did Peppa like better?
cells.a: She said, “I like our old car better.”
cells.cn: 她说还是更喜欢我们自己的旧车。

helper.order: First / Next / Then / After that / Finally
helper.keywords: car, drive, garage, roof, button, better
helper.actions: drive, mend, press, open, close, like

opener: Today I watched Peppa Pig. This episode is “The New Car”.
ending: In the end, Peppa says she likes their old car better. My favourite part is ______.
